description: This checkout's own OpenThrottle plugins, loaded in place. Generated by bundle-hooks; the public marketplace is .claude-plugin/marketplace.json at the repo root.
name: openthrottle-dev

plugins.description: Records which agent skills run under Claude Code, so OpenThrottle can report skill usage. Telemetry only — it never modifies your repository and never blocks a tool call.
plugins.name: openthrottle

plugins.description: OpenThrottle plan-run workflow hooks for Claude Code: delivers plan inbox messages before destructive steps, warns on edits with no task in progress, reports plan auto-close, narrates task transitions the model left unnarrated, warns on a second task going in progress or a committed task left in progress, settles abandoned runs, and requires an OT plan for session kickoffs.
plugins.name: openthrottle-workflow

plugins.description: Guards for Claude Code: catches shell commands that fail invisibly (zsh globs and modifiers, BSD sed, masked exit status, gh writes to closed PRs) and warns before MEMORY.md outgrows the session index. Works with or without an OpenThrottle server.
plugins.name: openthrottle-guards
